note: Both sets correctly extract the key parameters from the text box (-25.52E+6 watt/rad and 6.302336 deg) but both include inaccurate estimations of the graph's data points (e.g., claiming the last data point is -90E+6 when it is visually near -120E+6). Set A is better because Set B contains OCR-style typos in units ('watt/ra') and repeatedly misidentifies the specific parameter theta_K as the generic variable theta in entity names and quotes.
